selection.source: Labanyu 경매장 아이템 거래 TOP 300: seven-day trading-volume and total-traded-value rankings
selection.limitations: Rechecked the published rankings on 2026-10-01. The source still labels its data period as the seven days from 2025-12-14 04:00 KST; this is not a current-week trade observation. It samples the one-hour Nexon API by exact item name and excludes some item types. 4 locally unmapped names were excluded; duplicate local names use the lowest numeric ID only as a stable route key.
